newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $65, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $65, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower compared with last week, USDA said.
Wk to Date - 32,600 Last Week - 97,500 Year Ago - 79,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1175 lbs 63.50.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 4,000 slaughter steers and 1,900 heifers; 32,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 26,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
